newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Dairy Brands says expects lower yr profit.
newsitem.headline: Dairy Brands says expects lower yr profit.

text.p: Dairy Brands New Zealand Ltd on Wednesday said it had revised its profit forecasts for the full year downwards.

"Dairy Brands advised in the half year report that the operating surplus before abnormal items for the full year was expected to be up on last year. That position has now changed," Dairy Brands said in a statement.
It said the co-operative dairy companies supplied by Dairy Brands had confirmed that no premium would be paid over the New Zealand Dairy Board base price.
"Coupled with the ongoing lack of contribution from the Consumer Foods Division, this will mean that the operating surplus before abnormal items will be less than last year's result."
